question: What auspicious subject does the speaker now wish to hear concerning the deception practiced by time?
premises: The speaker expresses a wish now.
The object of that wish is to hear something.
That something is the auspicious account of the deception of time.
inference: The speaker now wishes to hear the auspicious account of the deception of time.
uncertainties: Content of that account not given here
plain_english: Now I wish to hear the auspicious account of the deception of time.
